title: Shared-module findings reduction and prioritized implementation backlog

completedFoundations.summary: Shared HTTP request helpers were created.
Shared search/risk request helpers were created.
Shared JSON file helpers were created.
Shared JSON gate harness tooling was created.
Shared-module boundary guardrails and waivers now fail on new architecture drift.
Manifest-driven migration codemod support now exists for repeated import rewrites.

priorityBatches.whyNow: The boundary guard now has an empty waiver list and should remain in place to prevent new runtime src/** -> tools/shared/** drift.

items.title: Migrate remaining runtime consumers off tools/shared/dict-utils.js
items.bestFix: Use the new migration codemod where possible, then shrink src/shared/dict-utils.js into a real canonical owner instead of a compatibility bridge.

items.title: Eliminate the last runtime import of tools/shared/search-request.js
items.bestFix: Move the caller fully to src/shared/search-request.js and delete the temporary wrapper once no consumers remain.

items.title: Hoist or replace tools/shared/index-state-utils.js for runtime sqlite usage
items.bestFix: Move the reusable state logic into a canonical src/shared or storage-local helper so runtime storage code no longer depends on tools/shared.

priorityBatches.whyNow: The root src/shared bucket still mixes generic helpers, domain owners, and compatibility bridges. This is the biggest source of future drift after the explicit tools/shared runtime debt.

progress.summary: First facade-deflation pass completed. Internal production code imports narrow concurrency and subprocess owners instead of root facades, deflated helper modules were moved into already-loaded owners or lazy async paths, and retrieval.cli stayed at the 1,134-module shared-module performance baseline.

Subprocess facade consumer follow-through completed. Tools, tests, and the bin entrypoint now import narrow subprocess owners directly; the only remaining root-facade mention is the intentional shared-module performance baseline descriptor.
Dead concurrency facade removed after all consumers moved to narrow concurrency owner modules.
Dead progress facade removed after consumers moved to progress-runtime and progress-context owners.
Progress-context env helper moved from src/shared/progress-context.js to tools/tui/supervisor/progress-context.js because the TUI supervisor is its only live owner.
Dead runtime-envelope facade removed after consumers moved to runtime-envelope/resolve and runtime-envelope/env-patch owners; retrieval.cli measured 1,131 transitive local modules.
Dead risk-explain facade removed after consumers moved to risk-explain-summary and risk-explain-model owners; retrieval.cli remained 1,131 transitive local modules.

Dead cache facade removed after consumers moved to cache/layers, cache/lru, and cache/size owners; syntax, ESLint, focused cache/indexing/retrieval tests, boundary checks, docs checks, cycles, and shared-module performance passed.
Dead subprocess facade removed after active consumers moved to narrow subprocess owners and the shared-module performance metric moved to subprocess/runner.
Legacy CLI entrypoint warning helper moved from the shared root to src/shared/cli/legacy-entrypoint.js.
Bounded object pool helper moved from the shared root to src/shared/workers/bounded-object-pool.js.
Optional artifact sync fallback helper moved from the shared root to src/shared/artifact-io/optional-fallback.js.
Cache CAS helper split from the shared root into focused cache-cas paths, metadata, objects, GC enumeration, and lease modules.
Auto-policy root facade removed after consumers moved to src/shared/auto-policy/build.js.
Command-registry root facade removed after consumers moved to command-registry-data.js and command-registry-query.js; the shared-module performance probe now measures the query owner.
ONNX helper root files moved under src/shared/onnx-embeddings/{config,run-queue,tokenization}.js while keeping the public src/shared/onnx-embeddings.js import surface stable.
CLI completions renderer moved from src/shared/cli-completions.js to tools/cli/completions-renderer.js because its only live consumer is the completions CLI tool.

Runtime capability builder helpers moved from src/shared/runtime-capability-builders.js to src/shared/runtime-capability/builders.js while keeping runtime-capability-manifest.js as the public assembler.

Root index-artifact helper removed after chunk_meta presence probes moved to src/shared/artifact-io/chunk-meta-presence.js and optional fallback/error helpers moved to src/shared/artifact-io/optional-fallback.js.

items.title: Split env/runtime/policy helpers out of src/shared root
items.bestFix: Create clearer family ownership for environment/runtime policy instead of leaving them in the generic root bucket.

items.title: Relocate root-only domain shims and re-exports
items.bestFix: Remove cross-layer re-exports and move specialized helpers to their owning subsystem or shared family.

items.title: Split large root-level domain helpers into narrower families
items.bestFix: Move language, embeddings, indexing-pointer, and timeout-policy owners into domain-specific shared families so dependencies and tests become easier to reason about.

priorityBatches.whyNow: Artifact/cache/io helpers are heavily imported and currently carry too many responsibilities. Splitting them improves both reviewability and the safety of future storage/indexing changes.

progress.summary: SQLite storage and index piece-assembly importers moved from src/shared/artifact-io.js to direct artifact-io owner modules for constants, JSON/JSONL streaming, loaders, and manifest contracts.
progress.result: Regenerated shared-module ledger reports src/shared/artifact-io.js at 66 direct consumers, down from 71 before this slice; no root artifact-io imports remain in the storage/sqlite and piece-assembly slice.

progress.summary: Bundle path/name/format helper consumers moved from src/shared/bundle-io.js to src/shared/bundle-io-paths.js, and checksum schema constant consumers moved to src/shared/bundle-io-constants.js.
progress.result: Regenerated shared-module ledger reports src/shared/bundle-io.js at 9 direct consumers; a guard verifies path/name/format/checksum helper imports no longer come from the behavior facade.

progress.summary: src/shared/bundle-io.js became a re-export-only facade while read/write/patch/checksum-worker support moved into src/shared/bundle-io/{read,write,patch,support}.js.
progress.result: Focused bundle behavior validation passed; root bundle-io facade guard passed; shared-module cycles and performance passed with retrieval.cli at 1,133 transitive local modules, still below baseline.

progress.summary: Manifest entry indexing, named path lookup, binary-columnar sidecar lookup, piece-by-path matching, and canonical variant selection moved from manifest-sources.js into manifest-entry-selection.js.
progress.result: Focused manifest/source-resolution validation passed; regenerated shared-module ledger classifies manifest-entry-selection.js under issue 411.

progress.summary: Pure columnar row inflation and iteration moved from loader shared state into src/shared/artifact-io/columnar-rows.js.
progress.result: Loader shared support no longer owns row materialization; SQLite artifact ingest imports the artifact family owner directly instead of a loader-internal helper.

progress.summary: Binary-columnar framed payload reading was separated from the async chunk_meta domain adapter while sync token_postings decode stayed local to preserve the sync API.
progress.result: Generic binary-columnar frame reading now stays schema-agnostic; chunk_meta binary-columnar semantics live in a lazy async adapter, and token_postings keeps its synchronous binary-columnar path without expanding the cold import graph.

progress.summary: retrieval/import-graph artifact facade deflation moved retrieval-reachable callers to narrow artifact owners.
progress.result: Shared-module performance passes with shared.artifact-io at 73 transitive local modules and retrieval.cli at 1,132, below the 1,134 baseline.

progress.summary: JSONL worker compression pooling split from jsonl-batch.js into src/shared/json-stream/jsonl-compression-pool.js while batch writer lifecycle stayed in jsonl-batch.js and sharded writers import the pool directly.
progress.result: JSONL batch writing no longer owns worker-pool lifecycle, preserving the existing writer API while narrowing compression-pool ownership.

progress.summary: JSON-stream byte accounting and checksum hashing split from streams.js into src/shared/json-stream/byte-counter.js while streams.js kept stream construction, event waits, atomic cleanup, and compression piping.
progress.result: JSON stream lifecycle and byte/checksum accounting now have separate owners without changing the createJsonWriteStream/writeChunk public API.

progress.summary: Binary-columnar JSON row decode and row-count validation moved from core-binary-columnar.js into src/shared/artifact-io/loaders/core-binary-columnar-json-rows.js.
progress.result: Materialized and streaming binary-columnar JSON row loaders now share one decode/count contract while core-binary-columnar.js stays as a coordinator over context, checksum, frame reading, and decode owners.

progress.summary: Core streaming row format dispatch moved from core.js into src/shared/artifact-io/loaders/core-row-stream.js.
progress.result: core.js now stays as the public loader surface over manifest/source resolution and materialized/streaming owner modules instead of owning row materialization policy directly.

progress.summary: Artifact/cache/IO review split flags cleared. manifest.js is documented as a facade, cache.js is removed, schema/docmeta helpers live under contracts or metadata owners, and loader/json-stream internals now have narrow owners.

items.title: Break up artifact-io manifest and loader cores
items.bestFix: Separate manifest description, cache lookup, filesystem helpers, and loader orchestration so each piece has a narrower API.

items.title: Split generic bundle/file/persistence helpers by responsibility
items.bestFix: Untangle write orchestration, the deleted files facade handoff, path/read helpers, and direct atomic persistence owner contracts into smaller focused modules.

items.title: Move schema-oriented helpers out of generic storage buckets
items.bestFix: Treat schema and docmeta helpers as contract-domain modules rather than generic artifact IO utilities.

priorityBatches.whyNow: These modules sit on critical execution paths. Their current size and mixed responsibilities increase the risk of regressions in queueing, process supervision, and progress semantics.

items.title: Split correctness-critical subprocess and lock modules
items.bestFix: Completed. Subprocess tracking is split into runtime, terminate, register, and scope leaves; runner.js remains a facade over async/sync/error leaves; file-lock acquisition remains in file-lock.js while constants, timing, info, owner, stale cleanup, release, and metrics live in focused lock leaves. Startup-sensitive build/tooling paths lazy-load lock behavior.

items.title: Deflate generic progress and scheduler-core controllers
items.bestFix: Completed. The progress root facade is removed, supervisor progress context is tool-owned, and adaptive-controller is already split into signal, snapshot, surface-decision, and token-policy leaves.

progress.summary: Tracked subprocess ownership split completed. tracking.js is now a facade over tracking-runtime.js, tracking-terminate.js, tracking-register.js, and tracking-scope.js; startup-sensitive src paths import narrow leaves directly, heavy indexing/tooling modules lazy-load the scope-only owner, and stale split flags for runner.js and adaptive-controller.js were closed because those files are already composition facades over focused leaves.

File-lock runtime split completed. file-lock.js stays the public acquisition facade; file-lock-runtime.js is now an internal aggregation surface over constants, timing, metrics, info/payload parsing, owner probing/removal, stale cleanup, and release-error leaves. Build/tooling paths imported by retrieval CLI lazy-load lock behavior at execution time, keeping retrieval.cli under the shared-module performance baseline.

priorityBatches.whyNow: This family is important, but the work is less correctness-sensitive than the runtime and storage batches above.

items.title: Split display/render and command registry surfaces
items.bestFix: Complete: display state/event/layout/palette/frame ownership is split, dispatch projection helpers live in command-registry-query.js, and runtime-capability surface assembly lives in runtime-capability/surfaces.js.

items.title: Relocate dispatch environment helpers away from tools/shared coupling
items.bestFix: Complete: the CLI-only runtime-env adapter moved out of src/shared to bin/dispatch-runtime-env.js, where tool config helper dependencies belong.

progress.summary: Display facade state/event split completed. src/shared/cli/display.js remains the public createDisplay facade, display task/log state mutation moved to src/shared/cli/display/state.js, and JSONL log/task event writing moved to src/shared/cli/display/events.js.

Display render split completed. render.js remains the row assembler while layout.js owns task ordering/sizing/detail layout, palette.js owns palette/theme state, and frame.js owns frame construction plus terminal row-diff writes.
skipped: perf/bench/run exceeded the 30-second repository cutoff in temp/validation/cli-display-render-split-focused-tests-20260520-121247.log

progress.summary: Dispatch registry projection cleanup completed. src/shared/command-registry-query.js now owns dispatch projection/query helpers and src/shared/dispatch/registry.js is a thin public facade.
Dispatch runtime-env adapter relocated from src/shared/dispatch/env.js to bin/dispatch-runtime-env.js, removing the src/shared dependency on tool config helpers while preserving CLI runtime behavior.
Runtime-capability flag-set and surface assembly moved to src/shared/runtime-capability/surfaces.js while runtime-capability-manifest.js remains the public manifest API.

priorityBatches.whyNow: The scan artifacts identified many duplicate clusters, but not all of them deserve immediate action. This batch should target the highest-frequency seams first.

items.title: Prioritize repeated repo/workspace/path/env handling seams
items.bestFix: Direct-execution, repo/workspace identity, run-node helper adoption, and timeout-proof follow-through are current. Continue only when a fresh governance failure, measured regression, or duplicate-audit refresh identifies a concrete seam.

items.title: Target repeated search/report/progress/logging clusters next
items.bestFix: Use a future intentional duplicate-audit refresh to drive the next round of narrow shared-module creation or adoption. Do not rework stale saved-report entries.

progress.summary: Direct-execution guard adoption completed for the first P2 follow-through slice. tools/tooling/install-lua-language-server.js, tools/ci/run-suite.js, tools/eval/risk-pack.js, tools/config/contract-doc.js, tools/mcp/server-sdk.js, and tools/bench/query-generator.js now use src/shared/direct-execution.js, and tests/tooling/shared-adoption-contract.test.js covers those entrypoints.

VS Code Windows command mirror adoption completed. extensions/vscode/windows-cmd-core.cjs now matches the shared bare-shim resolver contract, including env-aware PATH probing and resolveWindowsCmdShimPath export, and tests/tooling/vscode/windows-cmd.test.js pins parity with src/shared/subprocess/windows-cmd.js.

Native rebuild npm execution now uses spawnResolvedSubprocessSync('npm', ...) so Windows command-shim handling comes from the shared subprocess command-invocation owner while rebuild-native keeps its env and failure policy local. Package-name validation is also shared before rebuild and install-script paths diverge.

Run-node/helper adoption timeout-proof follow-up closed the remaining known scan-20/scan-21 proof caveats with bounded production-path fixtures and split selectors. No known behavior-proof timeout selector remains from this adoption batch.

deferOrDrop.title: Do not generalize every duplicate filename stem into a shared module
deferOrDrop.reason: Many stem collisions in the ledger are domain-local and would create weak abstractions if hoisted prematurely.

deferOrDrop.title: Do not expand the codemod beyond exact-specifier migrations until a stable seam is proven
deferOrDrop.reason: Broad AST rewrites would create more review risk than value at this stage.

deferOrDrop.title: Do not tighten the tools/shared boundary beyond the current waiver-backed rule without a separate policy decision
deferOrDrop.reason: The current guard is intentionally narrow; stricter boundary policies need a separate policy decision and test update now that the waiver list is empty.
